explication: Airbyte is an open-source data movement platform. The principal workflow is a configured sync: a source connector checks and discovers available streams, reads records and state, then a destination parses and transforms incoming messages, batches them, and writes them to a warehouse, lake, or database. The tree shows substantial bulk source and destination CDK runtime modules, plus connector-specific integrations. The graph focuses on that runtime path; several links between unsampled stages are marked dashed because the excerpts do not establish their dispatch or call sites.
